import json, subprocess, sys, random, traceback

atoms=[{"quantifier":"all","from":0,"to":7,"predicate":{"cmp":"le","left":{"scale":-1000,"term":tree(1)},"right":tree(1)}} for _ in range(20)]

queries=[mk_trace("q0","s0",[rand_row() for _ in range(1031)])]
req={"version":1,"window":K,"schema":fields,"atoms":atoms,"policy":{"max_width":4,"min_support":1,"min_witness":1},"train":train,"probes":probes,"queries":queries}
